name: Ritz-Carlton, Xi'an
positioning: City hotel (officially The Ritz-Carlton, Xi'an) in the central business district, with a full-floor spa and a rooftop bar
best_for: Travelers who want a business-district base with a spa and rooftop bar
Families with children who would enjoy an in-room camping experience

facts.text: The hotel is set within Xi'an's central business district.
The spa occupies an entire floor.
Spa guests have access to a zen garden, relaxation lounges, a sauna, a whirlpool and an indoor pool.
Xian Kitchen is an all-day restaurant with local and international cuisines, buffets and an a la carte menu.
The Lobby Lounge serves the hotel's signature Afternoon Tea.
Flair, the rooftop bar and restaurant, offers cocktails, Southeast Asian-inspired tapas and a sushi counter.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
The hotel offers a Club Lounge with exclusive services and a terrace.
Self parking is complimentary for in-house guests.

highlights.text: A private elevator ride leads to Flair, the rooftop bar and restaurant, which has a 180-degree city view.
The Ritz Kids Safari begins with a night camping in tents in the guest room.
At Tasuro teppanyaki restaurant, guests can watch the chefs' knife skills.
Couples can retreat to a spa suite with a private balcony.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
Breakfast at Xian Kitchen is available for a fee.
